description: Tropical equinox and solstice instants. Directly gates the tropical_seasons migration deferred in docs/engine-boundary-audit.md section 4.

source.notes: UNPOPULATED. REQUIRED. State the definition used: geocentric apparent solar longitude reaching 0/90/180/270 degrees TROPICAL, and the timescale of the published instant (UTC vs TT — these differ by delta-T, ~69 s today, which is larger than the 60 s tolerance). Do not fill from this engine's own output — the loader rejects a self-referential authority.

tolerance.rationale: Observatory-published equinox instants are given to the minute or better. 60 s is far tighter than the ~8 s difference between the current Meeus series and Swiss Ephemeris, so this dataset can adjudicate between them rather than merely tolerate both.
